title: Winslow gets its own area in the Ancient Borderlands (W15, first move): searches for Winslow find our town and its guide
why: 0181 §1 gate 3. The paths run of 2026-11-27 09:51 UTC showed "We have no listings in Winslow" above 17 and 1 results, and no guide offered. The cause is data: Winslow's ZIP 86047 sits in no area (micro_clusters), so search reads Winslow as outside our areas (UniversalSearch::clusterForZips). The fix follows 0170 §2's cascade, an existing town or else a town in its zone: regions.md names Winslow in 1A, so its area goes under the zone of the Greater St. Johns Area, slug by 0042's formula. The town (anchors) follows within the hour (Guides::syncTowns), and its guide comes in E.1's ring. Tier 4 review: CEO (as CTO), 2026-11-27, Prior Ruling Check yes (0170 §2, §5, §6 and its 2026-11-27 note, 0181's W15 note, regions.md 1A, 0042), approved on seven conditions, condition 5 as 0170 §2's cascade. Tested: tools/w15-tests/winslow.php, 8 checks on MariaDB, run twice. Independent CMO check (7), 2026-11-27: pass with six conditions, recorded here. For this release: (1) nations' land, as corrected by Jason (2026-11-27: "Town names on nations' land: this is a public known domain issue, address it as we've outlined and correct this pattern if it blocks us for accuracy regarding public domain"): a town on a nation's land takes its public name automatically, shown with Nations::label() and Nations::rules(), and the nation's own name beside it where public sources give it, credited (0164 R2, R7 Public tier). Only a story-only site's public source needs a person's confirmation. Winslow is off a nation's land; (2) story-only and held places: none placed; (3) Round Valley's 1b slug, (4) permanent redirects and GO Codes, (5) Pulse steps for moved pages: this release changes no slug, merges nothing and moves no listing, so they apply to W15 release 2, which does; (6) FAQ: "How does Traversence decide which area a place belongs to?" is added here, and "Why did my town's page address change?" comes with release 2, when addresses first change. Pattern check (the CEO, 2026-11-27), read from live: 1A is one cluster per town or district (1 The Greater St. Johns Area, 2 Round Valley, 47 The Show Low District, cluster-auto-holbrook), so Winslow as its own cluster follows it. Holbrook is about 33 mi away, past 0042's 20-mile joining radius. Accepted by the CEO as scoped.

changes.what: Searching Winslow, AZ (or places to stay, eat or see there) finds Winslow as one of our towns, with no "We have no listings" note over its results
Winslow's area page and, within the hour, its town; its guide follows in the 1A guide ring
FAQ: "How does Traversence decide which area a place belongs to?"

data_reason: Inserts one row into micro_clusters (Winslow, ZIP 86047, under the Greater St. Johns Area's zone), its id named MAX(id)+1, only if no area already covers 86047 and only if that zone is found. No other row is changed or deleted. Undo: delete that one row while nothing points to it. Check on live after publish: one micro_clusters row with slug cluster-1a-winslow. Roll back: DELETE FROM micro_clusters WHERE slug = 'cluster-1a-winslow' while no listing points to it.
